report.success_criterion: On the buggy revision, the test will FAIL because scalar_search_wolfe2 does not return (alpha_star=None, derphi_star=None) for the provided phi/derphi with amax=0.001; instead it triggers the incorrect invalid-state condition when alpha0 becomes exactly equal to amax after clipping, leading to the convergence-failure/warning behavior and an outcome inconsistent with the test’s non-convergence assertions. On the fixed revision, scalar_search_wolfe2 uses the corrected condition (amax is not None and alpha0 > amax), so with amax=0.001 and the same phi/derphi it properly returns (alpha_star=None, derphi_star=None), making the test PASS.
